title: Gravity and Terminal
author: Tamsin Galloway
blurb: Lior Kavanagh, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
